:::: {.hero}
# Moving Together

::: {.stand}
A movement retreat. What happens when a room full of people stops moving the way
they think they should, and starts moving the way they actually feel, together?
:::
::::

This retreat brings together yoga, tantra and improvised movement, practised
alone, in pairs and as a whole group. Some sessions start from breath and
awareness. Others open space for play and creative expression, where you follow,
lead, mirror and respond to the people around you, and find out what a group can
do that no one can do alone.

Over the days, a group of strangers becomes a group that moves together. Old
habits soften, attention widens from your own body to the bodies around you, and
there is room to be seen as you are, and to meet others more authentically. No experience is
needed, and there is no right way to do any of it.

Everything happens within clear agreements, with care around touch and
connection, and the freedom to take part at your own pace.

:::: {.about}

::: {.ab}
[Who it is for]{.k}

Anyone curious about movement, connection and creativity, whether you have
practised for years or are just beginning.
:::

::: {.ab}
[When]{.k}

Tentatively September 2027.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Where]{.k}

Germany.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Touch]{.k}

Some exercises involve touch between participants, such as a hand on the back
or leaning into each other's weight. Touch is always optional: you can say no,
or change your mind, at any time without giving a reason, and there is always a
way to take part without it. Nothing in the retreat is sexual, and everyone
stays clothed.
:::

::: {.ab}
[Language]{.k}

English.
:::
